name: BOSS
about: Reads every incoming request, decides which department owns it and hands it over with a reason.

boss.does: Weighs each request against what the departments own and sends it to the one best placed to deliver it.

chief-of-staff.role: Keeps the Boss's desk in order
chief-of-staff.does: Drafts short briefs and status notes for the Boss and handles requests that belong to no department.
